title: a unit literal inside a constraint body is the spec's bracket expression and parses
note: FIXED 2026-09-03. `require constraint { uav.mtow <= 25.0 [kg] }` was a parse error: the grammar had no bracket production inside expressions and only read a unit as a pseudo-multiplicity trailing a feature value, so a dimensioned feature could only be compared with a bare number. `[` is now the KerML BracketExpression postfix (`BaseFunctions::'['`, quantity overload `QuantityCalculations::'['`), the value-position unit still folds to `attrs.unit`, and the unit-aware evaluator judges both sides: 18.5 kg <= 25.0 kg is satisfied, with nothing to report.
